name: Predictions Of The Future
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly foretells the future to provide hope and assurance to His people, as seen in His promise of victory over evil in Genesis 3:15 and His plans for an expected end of peace in Jeremiah 29:11. The Bible warns of challenges within the church, including false teachers who will arise to lead believers astray (Acts 20:30), emphasizing the need for vigilance. The prophetic writings, especially in Revelation 1:1, confirm that God reveals forthcoming events to prepare His servants for what must soon take place. Ultimately, these predictions remind believers of the certainty of judgment after death (Hebrews 9:27) and encourage endurance and hope through the study of Scripture (Romans 15:4).
